description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Attach Holy with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Holy Mode I: Hope] and [Holy Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Holy Mode I: Hope
description.text: Holy abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Holy abilities trigger 2 additional times, casts Dual Unwavering Justice after using Holy abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Holy Mode II: Hope], removes [Dual Awoken Holy Mode I: Hope]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Holy Mode II: Hope
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 20000, Holy abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Holy abilities trigger 1 additional time, grants [Quick Cast 1] and [Holy Ability +30% Boost 1] after using Holy abilities

description.name: Dual Unwavering Justice
description.text: Four single attacks (2.04 each), grants smart ether 1 and [Quick Cast 1] to the user every second cast

description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3
